newsitem.title: UK: BoE's George says MPC votes to be recorded by name.
newsitem.headline: BoE's George says MPC votes to be recorded by name.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Wednesday that any disagreement on policy within the Bank's monetary committee would be reflected in the minutes, with the votes of each member recorded by name.

"The way in which votes are cast will be identified by the names of individuals," he told the House of Commons Treasury Select Committee. "Where an individual votes against the majority view, then that individual will set out their reasons for taking a different view."
Minutes of the monetary policy's first meeting in June did not include such a breakdown because all members present agreed to raise base rates by a quarter-point.
